title: chore(pm): queue guard refusal hints follow PD14 dequeue; record the live pr_dequeue reading
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTFATNfMJ3wCadH4nywTxtZ)_

Part of #33768
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么**:队列守卫两条拒收提示(受管面、超行数)的第一步改为:在队 PR 由其落地席发中继 `pr_dequeue`,其他席位或该笔未落地才请维护者手动移出;自测钉子同步。`platform-readings.md` 记一行实测出队读数,`landing-operations.md` 一行指给落地席。
- **为什么改**:AGENTS.md 第 14 条(已落地)写明落地席可发 `pr_dequeue`,守卫提示仍说「没有席位动作能出队」,把每个席位都送去找维护者,与规则相反。
- **风险与回滚**:只改提示文字、注释与自测钉子,判定逻辑不动;回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个提交。
- **先看**:`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 1990–1999 与 2959–2968(两条提示正文)、5162–5205(钉子)。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` → 581 cases pass。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(Tier H:守卫是受管面自身的门)。

### AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14, as landed (merge `3bf9c5c4`), quoted verbatim

> **Already armed or queued when you read this?** Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to **draft**, which disarms
> an unqueued PR; a queued one's landing seat sends the relay's `pr_dequeue` (measured live, comment 6902190812); any
> other seat, or a stroke that does not land, asks the maintainer at once — then confirm from the remote that it is
> in neither the queue nor `origin/main`.

## What changes

**Box A: the queue guard's refusal remedies follow PD14.** `renderGuardVerdict` and `renderSizeVerdict` step 1 now say: disabling auto-merge and converting to DRAFT do not take a queued PR out of the queue; its landing seat sends the relay's `pr_dequeue` AT ONCE (measured live, comment 6902190812); any other seat, or a stroke that does not land, asks the maintainer AT ONCE to remove it by hand; then disarm and confirm from the remote. The old text ("no seat act is measured to take it out of the queue") is gone. No new rule: the wording is PD14's.

Comments and pins kept in step:
- the remedy-order pin's first position is now `its landing seat sends the relay's \`pr_dequeue\` AT ONCE` (was `ask the maintainer AT ONCE`); its assert name drops `MAINTAINER-`;
- the queued pull-back battery's header comment, its `QUEUED_PULL_BACK` pins (the old "no seat act" and "ask the maintainer" pins replaced by three: not-out-of-the-queue, landing seat's `pr_dequeue`, any-other-seat asks the maintainer), its assert name and its battery name (`…: the landing seat sends the relay dequeue, never a DRAFT conversion`; the roster row renamed with it, count stays 4);
- the self-test's closing summary sentence.

The DRAFT-dequeue detector and its fixtures are untouched: a draft conversion still does not dequeue.

**Box B: the measured live dequeue.**
- `platform-readings.md`, queue membership: new row `中继 \`pr_dequeue\` 实测出队(run 43767458575,审计 6902190812):mutation 200,回读离队,仍开未合。` Read off the run's job log: `pr_dequeue: POST /graphql dequeuePullRequest -> HTTP 200 · #34097 out of the merge queue and still open, unmerged · read back 25 entr(ies), none is #34097 · audit comment 6902190812`.
- `landing-operations.md`, right after the dequeue cause lines: `该 op 实测离队见 \`platform-readings.md\`;在队受管面 PR 亦由落地席发(Prime Directive #14)。`

Paid in-family, both files stay at their ceilings (458, 112):
- `platform-readings.md`: the two lines "不在 `origin/main` 上是二义读数…两者处置相反" and "⇒ 落地检查恒两个读数…缺一不可" merged into one: `不在 \`origin/main\` 二义(在队等/没入队)⇒ 落地检查恒读两数:队列成员资格与 \`origin/main\`。` Cut: "两者处置相反" and "缺一不可", both carried by "恒读两数".
- `landing-operations.md` §D: "两棒散文互锁时分工由 PM 指派,允许前棒留占位交接。" and "PM 必须在两侧接力指令里写明谁动、谁不动。" merged: `…允许前棒留占位交接;PM 在两侧指令写明谁动、谁不动。` Cut: "必须", "接力".

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: 581 cases pass (581 at base; the battery's assertion count is unchanged).
- Ablation (scratch copy, restored): changing the size remedy's "So its landing seat sends" back to an ask-the-maintainer opening → `✗ ⭐ every-size-refusal-kind-carries-the-SAME-pull-back`, 1 of 581 failed.

## Acceptance notes

- Tier H: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` is the governed surface's own gate. `skip-changeset` (no published file).
- Card boxes for the seat to tick: the two "Follower of PR #34256" boxes. N1, E1, D2, D4, N2 stay open.
- E1 (removal-to-merge gap) is still not measured: the run log carries no merge, the PR was dequeued and stayed open.

## Verification

Head `1f35f8d4` on base `ec6b5fd3`:
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 70; 68 exit 0; 2 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MEASURED, left to CI): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` (`@objectstack/formula` not built) and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` (CLI not built). Neither reads the three files here.
- `--ran`: 70 derived, 68 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
- Among the 68: `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` (581 pass), `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (platform-readings 458/458, landing-operations 112/112), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (118 files clean), `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:nul-bytes`.
